newsitem.title: USA: GAO American/BA competition proposal details.
newsitem.headline: GAO American/BA competition proposal details.

text.p: The following are the details of a U.S. General Accounting Office suggestion issued Wednesday to boost competition at London's Heathrow airport and that might satisfy concerns posed by the proposed alliance between British Airways' and American Airlines.

- At least two additional daily roundtrips to Heathrow for Delta Air Lines for use from Atlanta and/or Cincinnati in order to maximize the one-stop competition for consumers in the Dallas-London and Miami-London markets,
- At least one additional daily roundtrip to Heathrow for US Airways from each of its three secondary hubs -- Boston, Charlotte and Pittsburgh -- that would otherwise be dominated by the alliance,

- At least one daily roundtrip to Heathrow for Continental Airlines, Northwest Airlines and Trans World Airlines from their secondary transatlantic hubs (Houston, Minneapolis, and St. Louis, respectively),

- At least two daily roundtrips to Heathrow for each of the other three U.S. airlines -- Northwest, United and US Airways -- from their primary hubs (Detroit, Chicago, and Philadelphia, respectively) to effectively utilize those hubs' competitive strengths,
- At least three daily roundtrips to Heathrow for each of the three U.S. airlines with primary hubs in the New York area -- Continental, Delta, and TWA.
